title: Post: flashlight on the Orchard Rd water tower

fields.text: Anyone else see a flashlight on top of the Orchard Rd water tower around 2am? And our tap water came out brown this morning. Should we be worried? @MillbrookDWS
fields.attachedImageBrief: phone photo of a glass of brownish tap water under a kitchen faucet
fields.attachedImageAlt: A glass of brownish tap water under a kitchen faucet

instructorNote: The public is ahead of the department. Watch for a holding line, not a denial.

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: Candid smartphone snapshot, slight tilt, natural color balance, neutral white balance. A close-up phone snapshot taken indoors, slightly tilted and blurred at the edges, showing a kitchen tap spouting clear water into a glass. The water appears faintly cloudy, with a wispy, translucent vapor trail rising from the surface, rendered as a subtle blue-gray haze to suggest chlorine odor. The background is a dimly lit kitchen with a countertop visible, a half-open refrigerator door in the far right, and a woman's hand (curly dark hair visible) holding the glass. The phone screen is slightly reflective, showing a faint blur of the woman’s face in the corner. The lighting is warm but muted, late afternoon. The glass and tap are unbranded, the water surface smooth with no visible bubbles or particles. Setting: a residential street with a utility crew around an open excavation, water running along the curb, a backhoe, neighbors watching, daylight

snapshot.title: Nextdoor Post: Chlorine Smell in Hilltop Zone

fields.avatarBrief: middle-aged woman with curly hair, wearing a gym outfit, holding a water bottle
fields.text: Just got home from the gym. Water from the tap tastes like bleach and smells like a swimming pool. My kid said it made her gag. Is the city doing something with chlorine? #MillbrookWater #HilltopZone #BoilWaterNow
fields.attachedImageBrief: phone photo of a kitchen tap with a clear glass of tap water, showing faint cloudiness and a visible chlorine odor particle effect (artistic rendering)
fields.attachedImageAlt: Tap water in a glass, slightly cloudy, with a visible chlorine vapor trail

snapshot.instructorNote: This is a public rumor spike; the PIO must log it and prepare a precautionary advisory. Watch for overreaction in customer service or uncoordinated public statements.
